summary: 36-year-old Golden climber fell approximately 40 feet on Sundance Buttress in the Lumpy Ridge area, sustaining numerous injuries; a Colorado Mountain School guide who witnessed the fall lowered him to the base of the route; a Grand Canyon helitack crew conducted a short-haul rescue; taken by ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center.
location: Sundance Buttress, Lumpy Ridge, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; Colorado Mountain School guide; Grand Canyon helitack crew
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry dated 2013-06-17 (Friday-verified). Merged run 720: original NPS 2013-06-14 news release (36yo Golden climber, 40-ft fall on Sundance Buttress, short-haul heli rescue by Grand Canyon Helitak crew from Big Meadows Fire).
